entries.decision: Decorate only an actual Common V2.0 XSD INVALID result where InternationalTextType uses the literal PDF-derived IBIS-IP wrapper shape instead of direct primitive Value/Language content.
guards: official Common V2.0 strict profile only
match only nested wrapper-shaped content inside InternationalTextType.Value and/or InternationalTextType.Language
must preserve direct xs:string and xs:language declarations as authority
must not register IBIS-IP.string or IBIS-IP.language wrapper shapes as aliases
must not rewrite invalid wrapper-shaped XML into a valid primitive shape
